seo.title: Best Fine Dining in Athens (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover the 12 top fine dining restaurants in Athens, Greece. From Michelin-starred elegance to breathtaking rooftop views, find your perfect gourmet experience. Explore exquisite Greek and international cuisine.

hero.subtitle: Athens' fine dining scene has blossomed, offering an exquisite blend of traditional Greek flavors with modern culinary artistry. From Michelin-starred establishments to stunning rooftop restaurants with Acropolis views, the city caters to the most discerning palates.

picks.name: Spondi
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A two-Michelin-starred institution, Spondi offers a refined and elegant dining experience set within a beautiful stone-built mansion with a charming inner courtyard. Chef Arnaud Bignon crafts exquisite dishes that blend French culinary techniques with the finest Greek ingredients, delivering subtle yet profound flavors. It's a journey of sophisticated tastes and textures.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Discovery Menu' for a comprehensive experience, or the 'Black Angus Beef' for a standout main.
picks.insiderTip: Book well in advance, especially if you desire a table in the enchanting courtyard during warmer months. Dress code is smart elegant.
picks.redditQuote: "Honestly, Spondi lives up to the hype. Every dish was a work of art, and the service was flawless. Pricey, but absolutely worth it for a special occasion."

picks.name: Botrini's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Helmed by celebrity chef Ettore Botrini, this Michelin-starred restaurant offers a playful yet sophisticated approach to Greek cuisine. Set in a stylish, contemporary space in Chalandri, Botrini's serves innovative dishes that surprise and delight, often incorporating molecular gastronomy techniques to transform familiar flavors into new culinary experiences. Expect a dynamic menu that frequently evolves.
picks.whatToOrder: The tasting menus are highly recommended to experience the chef's full vision. Look for dishes involving seafood.
picks.insiderTip: While in Chalandri, consider exploring the neighborhood's bustling bar scene before or after your meal for a local experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Botrini's was an adventure! The dishes were so creative and unexpectedly delicious. I wasn't sure what to expect from modern Greek, but this place nailed it."

picks.name: Hytra
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the 6th floor of the Onassis Cultural Centre, Hytra offers a Michelin-starred dining experience with breathtaking panoramic views of Athens, including the Acropolis. Chef Tasos Mantis champions modern Greek cuisine, focusing on seasonal, local ingredients presented with artistic flair and bold flavors. The experience is elevated by its stunning city backdrop.
picks.whatToOrder: Their 'Taste of Greece' tasting menu, and definitely pair it with a Greek wine recommended by the sommelier.
picks.insiderTip: Request a table by the window for the best views. Arrive slightly before sunset to enjoy the city transforming from day to night.
picks.redditQuote: "Hytra had incredible views of the Acropolis, and the food was just as good. So romantic, and the service was top-notch. Highly recommend for a special date."

picks.name: CTC
picks.whyItMadeTheList: CTC, another Michelin-starred gem, stands for 'Culinary Transformation Creation' and delivers on its promise. Located in a chic, minimalist space, Chef Alexandros Tsiotinis crafts innovative dishes that reimagine Greek ingredients with a global perspective. The focus is on a meticulously curated tasting menu, offering a journey through textures and unexpected flavor combinations. It’s a truly personalized and inventive dining experience.
picks.whatToOrder: The extensive 'Journey' tasting menu, which changes seasonally, is their signature offering.
picks.insiderTip: The restaurant is known for its intimate ambiance. Be prepared for a dining experience that encourages conversation and contemplation of each dish.
picks.redditQuote: "CTC blew me away. The tasting menu was so imaginative, and the presentation was incredible. Definitely a top-tier foodie experience in Athens."

picks.name: FG - Fine Gastronomy
picks.whyItMadeTheList: FG - Fine Gastronomy, formerly known as Funky Gourmet, is a two-Michelin-starred restaurant renowned for its avant-garde approach to Greek cuisine. Located near Monastiraki, it offers an immersive and theatrical dining experience, pushing the boundaries of traditional flavors and textures. Expect bold, artistic presentations and dishes that challenge perceptions in a sleek, contemporary setting. This is for adventurous palates.
picks.whatToOrder: Embrace the full tasting menu to fully appreciate their unique culinary philosophy and playful creations.
picks.insiderTip: Be open-minded and ready for an experimental culinary journey. Some dishes incorporate surprising elements, which is part of its charm.
picks.redditQuote: "FG was an absolute mind-bender. My tastebuds went on a rollercoaster! Not for everyone, but if you love experimental food, this is your spot in Athens."

picks.name: Aleria
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Housed in a beautiful neoclassical mansion with a romantic courtyard, Aleria offers a sophisticated take on modern Greek cuisine. Chef Gikas Xenakis masterfully reinterprets classic dishes, infusing them with contemporary techniques and unexpected twists while respecting their heritage. The ambiance is elegant yet warm, perfect for both intimate dinners and celebratory gatherings.
picks.whatToOrder: Don't miss the 'Lamb with Smoked Eggplant' – a truly memorable dish. Their wine list is also excellent, featuring many Greek labels.
picks.insiderTip: During warmer months, request a table in their stunning outdoor courtyard for a truly magical dining experience.
picks.redditQuote: "Aleria was such a pleasant surprise. The food was so refined but still felt genuinely Greek, and the courtyard was absolutely beautiful. A perfect evening."

picks.name: Sense Restaurant (AthensWas Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 7th floor of the AthensWas Hotel, Sense Restaurant boasts one of the most iconic Acropolis views in the city. Under Chef Alexandros Charalambopoulos, the cuisine is modern Greek, focusing on fresh, high-quality ingredients with a creative touch. It's an ideal spot for a romantic dinner where the food is as impressive as the breathtaking historical backdrop.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of the tasting menus provide excellent value and highlight their seasonal offerings. The 'octopus with fava' is often a standout.
picks.insiderTip: Book a table well in advance and specifically request a table with an unobstructed Acropolis view for the best experience.
picks.redditQuote: "The view from Sense was unbelievable, truly epic with the Acropolis lit up. The food was delicious too, really elevated Greek flavors. Made my trip."

picks.name: The Zillers Roof Garden
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated atop The Zillers Boutique Hotel in Plaka, this stylish roof garden offers incredible, close-up views of the Acropolis and Metropolitan Cathedral. The menu features modern Greek and Mediterranean dishes prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients. It's a slightly more casual fine dining option, perfect for an elegant lunch or dinner with a view that's hard to beat.
picks.whatToOrder: Their creative salads and fresh seafood dishes are always excellent. The cocktails are also fantastic.
picks.insiderTip: It's popular for brunch as well, offering the same stunning views in a brighter, more relaxed setting.
picks.redditQuote: "Zillers Roof Garden has the best Acropolis view, hands down. The food was really solid, not mind-blowing but consistently good, and the vibe was just perfect."

picks.name: GB Roof Garden
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched on the top floor of the iconic Hotel Grande Bretagne, the GB Roof Garden offers a quintessential luxurious dining experience with unparalleled views of the Acropolis, Syntagma Square, and the Parliament. The menu leans towards classic Mediterranean and international dishes, executed with precision and elegance. It's a timeless destination for a sophisticated meal in a grand setting.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Lobster Risotto' or any of their expertly prepared seafood dishes are highlights. Don't forget their impeccable dessert trolley.
picks.insiderTip: This is a prime spot for afternoon tea with a view, as well as dinner. Dress smart, and savor the old-world luxury.
picks.redditQuote: "GB Roof Garden felt like stepping into a movie. The service was impeccable, and the Acropolis view at night was just magical. Food was classic luxury, exactly what I expected."

picks.name: Tudor Hall (King George Hotel)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located on the 7th floor of the historic King George Hotel, Tudor Hall Restaurant offers a regal setting with exquisite neoclassical decor and a breathtaking view of the Acropolis and the city. The cuisine is contemporary Greek, focusing on refined flavors and elegant presentation. It's known for its sophisticated ambiance and attentive, old-world service.
picks.whatToOrder: Their traditional Greek dishes are elevated to fine dining status – try the 'Moussaka' or 'Lamb Kleftiko' for a luxurious twist.
picks.insiderTip: They also offer an excellent breakfast buffet with the same stunning views. It's a great way to experience the ambiance at a different pace.
picks.redditQuote: "Tudor Hall was absolutely gorgeous, felt like royalty. The food was so delicious and the view of the Acropolis was insane. A bit formal, but worth it for the experience."

picks.name: Nolan
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nolan stands out for its unique and critically acclaimed Japanese-Greek fusion cuisine. Chef Sotiris Kontizas, known for his innovative approach, blends umami-rich Japanese flavors with fresh Greek ingredients in a chic, minimalist setting. It's a more casual fine dining experience, offering shareable plates that are both comforting and exciting, perfect for a dynamic meal with friends or family.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Sake-marinated Salmon' and the 'Kakavia Ramen' are legendary. Don't skip their creative cocktails.
picks.insiderTip: Nolan is incredibly popular and doesn't take reservations for small parties, so arrive early or be prepared to wait. It's a bustling spot.
picks.redditQuote: "Nolan is hands down my favorite in Athens. The Japanese-Greek fusion sounds weird but it WORKS so well. Everything is incredible, especially the salmon. Just go!"

picks.name: Cookoovaya
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Cookoovaya, meaning 'owl' in Greek, is a stylish and bustling restaurant known for its 'five chefs, one cuisine' concept. It offers refined modern Greek and Mediterranean dishes with a focus on high-quality, seasonal ingredients. The atmosphere is vibrant yet sophisticated, making it a favorite for both locals and visitors seeking excellent food in a chic, lively setting. Portions are generous and often suitable for sharing.
picks.whatToOrder: Their fresh fish, grilled to perfection, and the 'Truffle Risotto' are consistent favorites. Ask for daily specials.
picks.insiderTip: Cookoovaya is very popular; making a reservation is highly recommended, especially for weekend evenings.
picks.redditQuote: "Cookoovaya was fantastic. Loved the vibe, really lively, and the food was incredibly fresh and flavorful. The truffle risotto was divine. Definitely a step up from typical tavernas."

faq.question: What is the average cost of fine dining in Athens?
faq.answer: The average cost for a fine dining experience in Athens typically ranges from €70 to €150 per person, excluding drinks. Michelin-starred restaurants or venues with extensive tasting menus can be higher, often reaching €150-250+ per person. More casual high-end options like fusion or modern Greek bistros might start closer to €50-80 per person for a multi-course meal.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for fine dining restaurants in Athens?
faq.answer: Absolutely. For most fine dining establishments in Athens, especially Michelin-starred ones or those with popular rooftop views, reservations are essential. It's highly recommended to book several weeks in advance, particularly if you're visiting during peak season or have a specific time or view preference. Some places might require a deposit for larger parties.

faq.question: What is the dress code for fine dining in Athens?
faq.answer: While Athens generally has a relaxed atmosphere, fine dining restaurants typically expect smart casual to elegant attire. For men, this usually means trousers (not shorts), a collared shirt, and closed-toe shoes. For women, a dress, skirt, or smart trousers with a blouse is appropriate. Avoid beachwear, athletic wear, or overly casual clothing.

faq.question: Are there fine dining restaurants with Acropolis views?
faq.answer: Yes, Athens is famous for its fine dining restaurants offering spectacular views of the Acropolis. Several top establishments, including Hytra, Sense Restaurant, The Zillers Roof Garden, GB Roof Garden, and Tudor Hall, provide breathtaking panoramic vistas, especially enchanting when the Acropolis is illuminated at night. These tables are highly sought after, so book well in advance and request a window seat.

faq.question: Is fine dining in Athens suitable for vegetarians or vegans?
faq.answer: Many fine dining restaurants in Athens are increasingly accommodating to dietary restrictions, including vegetarian and vegan preferences. While not all may have dedicated tasting menus, most can adapt dishes or create special vegetarian options if informed in advance. It is always best to mention your dietary needs when making a reservation to ensure the kitchen can prepare a suitable and enjoyable meal for you.

faq.question: What are the best neighborhoods for fine dining in Athens?
faq.answer: Fine dining in Athens is spread across various vibrant neighborhoods. You'll find a high concentration around the city center in areas like Syntagma and Plaka, offering stunning Acropolis views. Upscale residential areas like Kolonaki and Pangrati are home to several Michelin-starred gems, while neighborhoods like Metaxourgeio and Chalandri also boast top-tier culinary experiences. Each area offers a distinct ambiance alongside its gourmet offerings.

methodology: Our selection for Athens' best fine dining experiences is based on a comprehensive review of Michelin Guide accolades, expert culinary critiques, and aggregated diner reviews from trusted platforms. We prioritize venues offering exceptional food quality, innovative menus, impeccable service, and a memorable atmosphere, ensuring a truly premium gastronomic adventure.
